Perfect! I can see the issue clearly in the logs. The problem started at 03:02:44 UTC when Prometheus ran out of disk space: `"Failed to write to WAL" err="write /prometheus/wal/00004812: no space left on device"`. This explains the data gaps in Grafana dashboards and why alerts didn't fire - Prometheus couldn't persist the metrics.

Looking at the pod details, the PVC `prometheus-k8s-db-prometheus-k8s-0` has a capacity of 100Gi and the storage class `gp3-resizable` has `allowVolumeExpansion: true`, so the volume can be resized.

Let me search the Kubernetes documentation to confirm the proper way to expand a PVC.

input.query: expand persistent volume claim PVC resize
